profile.reading:
All About Serving is a legal process serving business at 1909 East Ray Road in Chandler, Arizona. Process servers deliver court summonses, subpoenas, complaints and other legal notices on behalf of attorneys, courts and litigants, and then file proof that service was made. The word server in the trade name refers to a person who serves legal papers. It has no relationship to computing hardware, and this record is in the registry only because of a tagging error that is fully documented in the map history.

The OpenStreetMap node was created on 1 June 2020 by a Maricopa County mapper working in the iD editor over Bing aerial imagery, in a 457 change edit whose comment reads simply road updates and building updates. In that first version the node carried exactly two tags, the business name and telecom=data_center. There was no address, no operator, no website and nothing else to check the classification against. Two and a half years later, in December 2022, a second mapper running RapiD added the postal address from the Esri USA NAD Addresses layer, which is where the Chandler street address in this record comes from. The address is correct. The data centre tag was never revisited.

The error is not isolated, and that is the point worth recording. A query of the OpenStreetMap database over the Phoenix metropolitan bounding box returns 54 objects tagged telecom=data_center, of which 19 were last edited by this same mapper. That set mixes genuine facilities, including Iron Mountain Data Centers AZS-1 and an EdgeCore building, with businesses that are plainly not data centres, among them Profit Finder Pro Software, K-Motion Interactive, StrongMind, Myndshift Technologies, DataPro USA Web Development, J-Curve Technologies, The Chatfield Group and this process server. The pattern is consistent with a mapper adding local business points from aerial imagery and repeatedly choosing a data centre preset for anything whose name sounds technical, or in this case merely contains the word server.

Left unreviewed, that one editor accounts for roughly a third of all data centre tagged objects in the Phoenix area, which is exactly how an automated harvest of telecom=data_center produces an inflated facility count for a metropolitan market that is genuinely important in the data centre industry. A registry that quietly dropped this row would lose the evidence. This registry keeps it, labelled for what it is.

reading.body:
This entry does not describe a data center campus. All About Serving Process Server is a legal services company that delivers court documents on behalf of attorneys and courts, operating from a street address in Chandler, Arizona. The word "server" in its name is a homonym coincidence unrelated to information technology infrastructure.

The facility appears in mapping databases as a mistagged point, likely because of the naming coincidence. No published specifications for IT infrastructure, power capacity, or colocation services exist for this address. Research has been exhausted without locating any connection between this legal services business and data center operations.

This campus does not matter to AI infrastructure. It publishes no power capacity, hosts no computing equipment, and performs no function relevant to the grid constraints on AI scaling.
